messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty trigger PD12345 — p99 latency > 3.0s on /v1/generate (us-west). Auto-page sent to rotation. link: https://grafana.redwood/pd/PD12345
jamal: acked — looking now.
maria: I'm on-call for SRE rotation, joining the thread. Any immediate customer reports?
jamal: no error spike, just latency. pulling grafana and logs.
oliver: quick grafana query I'm looking at — paste into explore:
```
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le)
```
jamal: graph shows p99 uphill from 1.2s -> 3.8s over the last 6m, p95 ~1.1s -> 1.6s.
oliver: logs snippet shows tokenizer hot path spiking (tokenize_ms):
```
[13:07:21] request_id=abc123 tokenize_ms=1180 model=v2-gen-2026 variant=fast-rank
[13:07:22] request_id=def456 tokenize_ms=1020 model=v2-gen-2026 variant=fast-rank
```
oliver: looks like the v2-gen rollout traffic is hitting heavier tokenization for some inputs. any recent deployments?
maria: product rolled v2-gen-2026 ~3h ago, small canary. traffic ramped to 40% earlier today.
sre-rotation: confirming — A/B config shows 40% -> v2-gen-2026 across us-west.
jamal: mitigation options: 1) rollback traffic to stable, 2) route long-token requests to smaller model, 3) emergency autoscale. I'll try a targeted rollback to 10% first.
maria: go for rollback to stable 90/10 and hold, we don't want full rollback without confirming.
jamal: running rollback:
```
/ops/traffic/rollout set --route /v1/generate --variant stable --percent 90 --region us-west
```
oncall-bot: autoscaler note — scaling action queued: add 2 instances to tokenizer-pool-us-west (expected up in ~60s).
jamal: rollback applied, verifying metrics...
maria: p99 dropping: 3.8s -> 2.1s in the first 60s, p95 stable. still above target but improving.
oliver: tokenizer latency still has tail for some heavy inputs; suspect a pathological prompt pattern we haven't seen in canary. pulling sample requests.
jamal: PD incident note update: partial degradation, suspect model variant increases tokenization overhead. rollback to stable underway. No increase in 5xxs; customer impact limited to higher latency for some heavy-token requests.
support: ping — should we draft a quick customer advisory or wait?
maria: wait — hold off until we see stable p99 < 1.5s for 10m or if error rate increases.
sre-rotation: will monitor for 30m, if p99 > 3s again escalate PD to level2.
jamal: leaving logs and runbook note: "tokenizer-warmup: observe heavy token counts -> consider short-circuiting to tokenizer-lite for >2000 tokens". Adding to PD12345.
oncall-bot: PD update — PD12345 acknowledged by jamal.
maria: preparing handoff notes for evening rotation in 20m: current status: rollback to 90% stable, autoscaler +2 requested, p99 trending down to ~1.8s.
jamal: I'll stay for 15m then handoff. maria, drop your contact in rotation channel if you leave early.
maria: will do. tagging @support to standby draft in case we need to notify customers.
support: noted — standby template ready.
oliver: follow-up action: blocklist the specific prompt pattern if it repeats and capture trace for model team.
jamal: agreed. if we don't regress in 15m I'll close the PD and file a post-incident with root cause "model variant increased tokenizer tail latency under certain long-token inputs".
maria: ack. monitoring.
incident-bot: PD12345 — status: in_progress; last update appended.
jamal: update 15m later — p99 steady at ~1.2s, closing keepalive window. If it drifts back, we'll reopen PD.
maria: handoff complete to evening rotation. leaving notes in #oncall-rotation.
incident-bot: PD12345 — resolved by jamal (close reason: mitigation rollback + autoscale stabilized latency).
